verdict.rationale: CSC is a corporate-services SaaS platform with the CSCNavigator dashboard, so asking whether users can opt out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair privacy-posture question. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics tracking, or any opt-out control. The pack covers registered agent, SOP, compliance calendar, and API integration features only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
